findings.location: rAF tick and ProcessScene progress effect
findings.evidence: Authoritative progress ref advances each rAF, but setProgress only at >=30ms feeds the sole normal model.update path. Deterministic cadence reproduction yields30 poses/sec at60Hz,25 at75Hz,30 at120Hz and28.8 at144Hz.
findings.whyWrong: The geometry cannot use available display cadence even when its update/render cost is small, creating avoidable stepwise motion.
findings.fix: Separate active geometry updates from throttled UI/session state publication; keep one authoritative progress, deterministic seeking/capture and paused demand rendering.
findings.verification: Deterministic scheduler tests plus real browser playback; no stale state rewinds, duplicate update per displayed frame, or paused update loop. Keep existing capture and render caching regressions.
